title: Democratizing LLMs for Low-Resource Languages by Leveraging their English Dominant Abilities with Linguistically-Diverse Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities in generative tasks (such as translation, summarization, question answering, and instruction following) between high-resource languages (e.g., English, French) and low-resource languages (e.g., Indic and African languages) using metrics like chrF++, ROUGE-L, and LLM-as-a-judge, while analyzing the impact of pre-training data imbalance and tokenization fragmentation.
